intro.text: Get to know yourself and go deeper through this beautiful ancient practice, with benefits you can truly feel from the very first class.

about.practiceText: Through yoga practice we can improve our health in an integral way. The search for physical, mental and emotional balance has become an increasingly clear need in this complex century. Whether you arrived here looking to release stress and improve your mental health, to build strength and flexibility, or while recovering from an injury, yoga can offer answers. We often arrive at our first class with concrete goals, and over time we not only see those goals unfold, but also discover many additional benefits. Priorities change, and we progress in ways we did not expect when we first came into contact with yoga. Body and mind gradually transform, and a sense of wellbeing and gratitude finds space in our lives, helping us move through both good and difficult moments. Yoga requires discipline, patience, equanimity and detachment. With time and the right attitude, answers appear. You do not need the best mat, nor a flexible or strong body. You only need attitude and presence.
about.classesText: In class we work progressively and adapt the practice to your level. Each session focuses on different points, looking to release and strengthen the whole body. We begin by warming up and entering the practice with sun salutations. Then we guide the asanas toward the focus of the day and finish with a delicious guided relaxation in savasana. In the one-hour-and-fifteen-minute classes we also include energetic work with pranayama, gradually exploring ways to guide and focus energy through the breath.
